ApproveRequest.description: Approve a plan revision: it must be the session's latest (ADR 0046).
ApproveRequest.title: ApproveRequest

Assumption.description:
One planning-request field (or a fact the plan relies on) as the agent read or inferred
it: its value in words, where it came from and how sure the agent is (ADR 0048).
Assumption.title: Assumption

AssumptionSource.description: Where an assumed value came from.
AssumptionSource.title: AssumptionSource

BindingConstraint.description:
A constraint that limits the plan: dropping it gives a strictly better objective, or,
when time ran out, one that may.
BindingConstraint.title: BindingConstraint

BindingEvidence.description: How sure the optimiser is that a constraint binds (ADR 0038).
BindingEvidence.title: BindingEvidence

Clarification.description: A question the agent asked and the manager's answer, in their own words.
Clarification.title: Clarification

ClarificationAsked.description: The Context agent paused to ask the manager these questions.
ClarificationAsked.title: ClarificationAsked

ClarificationQuestion.description: A specific question the agent asks instead of guessing (AG-02).
ClarificationQuestion.title: ClarificationQuestion

ClarifyRequest.description: Answers to the session's open clarification questions (ADR 0048).

answers.description: An answer in plain English for every open question, keyed by its id.
answers.title: Answers

ClarifyRequest.title: ClarifyRequest

ClearanceShortfall.description:
A clearance target the plan misses: no plan within the other constraints reaches it,
so the optimiser returned the plan that comes closest and reports by how much it falls
short (SPEC §9.4, F-06 AC2, ADR 0040).
ClearanceShortfall.title: ClearanceShortfall

ClearanceTarget.description:
The minimum sell-through the brief asks for a SKU it names for clearance, in every
region of the scope (ADR 0014, ADR 0040).
ClearanceTarget.title: ClearanceTarget

CompetitorGap.description: One SKU in one region against the competitor's latest price before the as-of week.

base_price.description: Our regular shelf price in rupees.
base_price.title: Base Price

competitor_on_promo.description: Whether that price was a competitor promo.
competitor_on_promo.title: Competitor On Promo

competitor_price.description: The competitor's latest price in rupees.
competitor_price.title: Competitor Price

cpi.description: Competitor price index: competitor price ÷ base price.
cpi.title: Cpi

gap.description: 1 minus CPI: how much cheaper the competitor is (< 0: dearer).
gap.title: Gap

price_week.description: The week of that price, before the as-of week.
price_week.title: Price Week

undercut.description: A KVI whose CPI is below 1 minus the undercut threshold.
undercut.title: Undercut

CompetitorGap.title: CompetitorGap

CompetitorGaps.description: The gaps for a scope, widest first, with the company-policy rules they were judged by.

kvi_price_tolerance.description: How far above the competitor a KVI promo price may sit, when enabled.
kvi_price_tolerance.title: Kvi Price Tolerance

CompetitorGaps.title: CompetitorGaps

CompetitorReaction.description:
The competitor-reaction scenario (F-09 AC2, ADR 0045): in each run, each plan line's
competitor matches its discount with this probability, independently of the other lines.

match_probability.description: Chance, per plan line and run, that the competitor matches our discount.
match_probability.title: Match Probability

CompetitorReaction.title: CompetitorReaction

lift.description: P(both in a basket) / (P(one) x P(other)).
lift.title: Lift

support.description: Share of baskets holding both SKUs.
support.title: Support

theta.description: Cross-price effect, or null if not estimable.
theta.title: Theta

ConstraintKind.description: A plan-level constraint the optimiser enforces (ADR 0036, ADR 0038).
ConstraintKind.title: ConstraintKind

ConstraintSource.description: Who set a constraint: only the brief's constraints may be relaxed (ADR 0007).
ConstraintSource.title: ConstraintSource

DecisionMade.description: A decision taken in the graph: a route a node chose, or a human's approve or reject.
DecisionMade.title: DecisionMade

FallbackReason.description: Why the template explained a plan revision instead of the LLM.
FallbackReason.title: FallbackReason

FindingRaised.description: Something the Critic found in the plan.
FindingRaised.title: FindingRaised

LineSimulation.description: One plan line's simulated ranges, identified by its SKU and region.
LineSimulation.title: LineSimulation

MechanismOption.description:
One promo option's expected numbers, as its prediction gave them (rupees, units over
its promo weeks; a BUNDLE's money fields include its partner).
MechanismOption.title: MechanismOption

MechanismOutcome.description: One mechanism in a comparison: its best option, or why it has none.
MechanismOutcome.title: MechanismOutcome

ModelEntry.description: One registered model version; `live` marks the one the API is serving.
ModelEntry.title: ModelEntry

ModelVersion.description: The registered model that produced the numbers, so a plan can be traced to it.
ModelVersion.title: ModelVersion

NodeOutcome.description: How a node's run ended: it finished, paused at an interrupt, or raised.
NodeOutcome.title: NodeOutcome

NodeStarted.description: A graph node started running (again, when an interrupted node resumes).
NodeStarted.title: NodeStarted

NotSelectedOption.description: The best option of a SKU and region with no plan line, and why it was left out.
NotSelectedOption.title: NotSelectedOption

NotSelectedReason.description: Why a promo option is not in the plan: a rule it breaks alone or added to the plan.
NotSelectedReason.title: NotSelectedReason

Percentiles.description: The 10th, 50th and 90th percentiles of one simulated metric across the runs.
Percentiles.title: Percentiles

PlanDecision.description:
One human decision on one plan revision: an approval or a rejection with its reason.
Every decision is kept, in order, as the session's audit trail (SF-04, ADR 0046).
PlanDecision.title: PlanDecision

PlanExplanation.description: What the Explainer wrote for one plan revision.
PlanExplanation.title: PlanExplanation

PlanLine.description: A promo option selected into a promo plan: one (SKU, region) decision (ADR 0004).
PlanLine.title: PlanLine

PlanRevision.description: One numbered version of the promo plan within a planning session.
PlanRevision.title: PlanRevision

PlanRevisionLine.description: A plan line with the expected numbers the planning tool computed for it (rupees).
PlanRevisionLine.title: PlanRevisionLine

PlanSimulation.description: What `simulate` returns for a promo plan, and what a plan revision stores.
PlanSimulation.title: PlanSimulation

PlanSimulationResponse.description: A plan revision's new simulation, now stored against it in place of the old one.
PlanSimulationResponse.title: PlanSimulationResponse

PlanningRequest.description:
Money is in rupees (ADR 0015). The brief's optional constraints may only tighten
company policy; a value that would loosen it is kept here as read, and planning applies
the policy value instead and flags it (ADR 0007, ADR 0040).

max_promoted_skus_per_category_per_regio.title: Max Promoted Skus Per Category Per Region

PlanningRequest.title: PlanningRequest

PolicyFinding.description:
A brief value that would loosen company policy: planning keeps the policy value and
flags it (ADR 0007, ADR 0040).
PolicyFinding.title: PolicyFinding

PromoWindow.description: The future weeks, inclusive, in which a plan's promotions must start and end.
PromoWindow.title: PromoWindow

PruneReason.description:
Why option generation dropped an enumerated promo option, in the order the rules are
applied (ADR 0035).
PruneReason.title: PruneReason

RejectRequest.description: Reject a plan revision, the session's latest, with the reason (ADR 0046).
RejectRequest.title: RejectRequest

RelationsResponse.description: A SKU's substitutes (strongest first) and complements (highest lift first).
RelationsResponse.title: RelationsResponse

Relaxation.description:
The smallest change to the brief's constraints that makes an infeasible request
feasible: the least sum of each change as a share of the brief's value (ADR 0044).
Relaxation.title: Relaxation

RelaxedConstraint.description: One brief constraint the relaxation changes, and by how much (ADR 0044).
RelaxedConstraint.title: RelaxedConstraint

RiskFinding.description:
One risk the Critic's review found, with feedback specific enough for the planner to act
on. Its numbers come from the plan's tool outputs, never from the LLM.
RiskFinding.title: RiskFinding

Scope.description: The regions and categories a planning request covers, optionally narrowed to SKUs.
Scope.title: Scope

Segment.description: A behavioural customer group; never defined by protected attributes.
Segment.title: Segment

SelectionReasonCode.description:
A positive part of a plan line's value (ADR 0005, ADR 0035), or the clearance target it
helps meet (ADR 0040).
SelectionReasonCode.title: SelectionReasonCode

SessionResponse.description: One planning session's read model: status, brief, planning request, latest revision.

assumptions.description: How the Context agent read the brief, each with its source and confidence (ADR 0048).
assumptions.title: Assumptions

clarifications.description: Every question answered so far, oldest first.
clarifications.title: Clarifications

decisions.description: Every approval and rejection, oldest first: the session's audit trail.
decisions.title: Decisions

questions.description: The clarification questions waiting for an answer (awaiting_clarification).
questions.title: Questions

usage.description: What the session's LLM calls used and cost: the sums of its token-usage trace events (ADR 0047).

SessionResponse.title: SessionResponse

SessionStatus.description:
Every status a planning session can have (ADR 0046).

planning -> awaiting_approval -> approved (final) or rejected (open for amendments); any
failure while planning -> failed; planning -> awaiting_clarification -> planning when the
questions are answered (ADR 0048).
SessionStatus.title: SessionStatus

SessionUsage.description: What a planning session's LLM calls used and cost: the sums of its token-usage events.
SessionUsage.title: SessionUsage

SimulatePlanRequest.description:
Re-simulate a session's latest plan revision (ADR 0043), optionally against a
competitor reaction (ADR 0045). The seed is configuration.

competitor_reaction.description: The competitor-reaction scenario; omit or null for a competitor that never reacts.

n_runs.description: Runs to simulate; omit for the configured default (SIMULATION_RUNS).
n_runs.title: N Runs

SimulatePlanRequest.title: SimulatePlanRequest

SimulatedOutcomes.description:
Ranges over the promo weeks, units capped at pooled available stock (ADR 0004, 0011).

Units and sell-through are the anchor SKU's; revenue, gross profit and promo spend
include a BUNDLE's partner (ADR 0017). Margin is gross profit over revenue in each run
(0 in a run with no revenue). Sell-through is None when there is no available stock.
SimulatedOutcomes.title: SimulatedOutcomes

theta.description: Cross-price effect: positive for a substitute.
theta.title: Theta

TargetSegment.description: Who a plan line is offered to: one segment exclusively, or All customers (ADR 0006).
TargetSegment.title: TargetSegment

TokensUsed.description: One billed LLM call: its model, tokens and cost, priced when it was made.
TokensUsed.title: TokensUsed

ToolCalled.description: A deterministic tool was called: its arguments and a summary of what it returned.
ToolCalled.title: ToolCalled

TraceEvent.description: One step of a planning session's trace.
TraceEvent.title: TraceEvent

TraceStreamEnd.description:
The last event of a session's trace stream (`event: end`): the session is final, so no
more trace events can come (ADR 0047).
TraceStreamEnd.title: TraceStreamEnd

Violation.description: One broken hard constraint, specific enough for the planner to fix.
Violation.title: Violation

WhyChosen.description:
Why a plan line was chosen: the positive parts of its value, what it is worth alone,
and whether it is the best option the optimiser could pick for its SKU and region.
WhyChosen.title: WhyChosen

get.description:
The session's trace events over SSE (SF-01, ADR 0047), in order, as they happen.

Each event's SSE `id` is its number in the session; a client that reconnects with
`Last-Event-ID` gets the events after it, with no gaps or repeats (a missing or
non-numeric one replays the trace from the start). Once the session is final
(approved, or failed) the stream sends `event: end` with its status and closes.
